correctness.summary: The folded likelihood is a finite coordinate-sign average of Gaussian likelihood ratios. Convexity and positivity transfer the exact full-Gaussian Rényi integrability threshold, finite sign expansion gives the integer determinant formula, and even-Hermite Parseval yields the order-two pair and triangle terms and the exact bivariate geometric sum.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The recent source supplies only a moment-based lower certificate for order-two Rényi total correlation. Searches of Gaussian-magnitude and multivariate folded-normal literature found no exact spectral integrability criterion, integer sign-determinant formula, bivariate -log(1-rho^4) identity, or even-Hermite total-correlation expansion. Older folded-normal papers remain a residual risk because two full texts were not completely inspected.

value.summary: The result gives a complete Rényi finiteness phase diagram for Gaussian magnitudes, exact computable formulas at integer orders, and a transparent weak-dependence geometry in which pair correlations first enter quartically and Gaussian triangles at sixth order.

limitations: The Gaussian correlation matrix is assumed positive definite.
Noninteger Rényi orders have a sharp finiteness criterion but no finite determinant-sum formula here.
The Hermite and weak-dependence expansions are specialized to order two.
No statistical estimator or finite-sample inference result is proposed.
Cross-model review has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Cross-model review: not yet performed.
